fieldValues.title: Every comment says what kind it is, and a task comment can be ticked off or rejected
fieldValues.move: A comment carries a kind: question, objection, evidence, suggestion or task. The editor shows the kind on each comment and lets the writer filter a paragraph's comments by kind. A task comment proposes one thing to do and carries a state: open, done or rejected, which the writer sets with one click, with an optional reason when rejecting. Agents read the state and do not propose a rejected task again. The kinds live in the shared comments package, so every package that uses comments reads the same list.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Threading or replies: a reply is still a later comment (semanticops.com#17). Which comments are shown when: that is pacing (remedy 800f223f). Writer-defined kinds.
fieldValues.falsifier: After a week of agent comments, the writer still reads every comment to know what it asks, or an agent proposes a task the writer rejected again.
fieldValues.return_when: After a week of writing with typed comments, or when a kind is needed that the list lacks.
